abi.return_semantics: Returns the opaque 32-bit receiver field word unchanged; no pointer cast, sign extension, truncation, or ownership operation occurs.

mechanics: ECX supplies the opaque receiver word.
The body performs one unaligned-semantics-independent four-byte load from receiver+0x54.
EAX receives all 32 bits without transformation.
The body contains no branch, call, write, allocation, reference-count operation, or ownership transfer.

sdk_conflict.repository_projection: PKG-11 NounProjection is 0xb4 bytes and exposes different noun-list and noun-map offsets.
sdk_conflict.resolution: The SDK label is layout evidence only. The two-instruction target does not independently prove the concrete receiver type, the field's SDK meaning, or its ownership, so staging retains OpaqueNounManager and an opaque uint32_t result.

null_and_mutation_behavior.null_receiver: No guard exists; a null receiver performs an unchecked load at address 0x54 and faults.
null_and_mutation_behavior.near_null_receiver: No range or alignment guard exists; an invalid near-null receiver faults when address 0x54 is inaccessible.
null_and_mutation_behavior.null_field_value: A stored zero word returns zero unchanged.
null_and_mutation_behavior.near_null_field_value: A stored near-null word such as 0x00000001 returns unchanged.
null_and_mutation_behavior.mutation: No receiver or field byte is written.

call_graph.consumer_boundary: The high fan-in establishes broad noun-manager-compatible use but does not prove that every caller supplies the same concrete SDK type.

evidence.observation: Live decompilation is an ECX-only four-byte return from param_1+0x54.
Exact assembly is MOV EAX,dword ptr [ECX + 0x54]; RET.
Live Ghidra reports 303 unique direct caller functions.
The imported SDK type is 284 bytes and places cCreatureAnimalPtr at +0x54; this is retained only as conflicting layout evidence.
The integrated consumer passes the noun-manager return in ECX and consumes the resulting field as an opaque object pointer before a later virtual call.
The SDK names the +0x54 member mpAvatar, but the accessor assignment intentionally does not promote that semantic.

verification.diff_command: git diff --check plus per-file git diff --no-index --check

verification_results.instruction_parity: passed; emitted mov eax,DWORD PTR [ecx+0x54]; ret

unresolved_questions: Does every one of the 303 direct callers pass the same concrete noun-manager receiver type?
What concrete object, if any, the opaque +0x54 word represents across all callers.
Which owner publishes, replaces, and tears down noun-manager receivers.
What values are observed at +0x54 in the original process.
blockers: Original-process noun-manager availability and field values remain runtime-gated.
